supporting_features.name: Four deterministic retail operations
supporting_features.detail: Routes product lookup, customer assistance, task checklist, and performance dashboard requests from persona language.

supporting_features.detail: Accepts bundled synthetic records, rejects other data sources, and stops on unknown identifiers rather than inventing facts.

supporting_features.detail: Treats stock as unverified, scripts and checklists as drafts, and recommendations as evidence for authorized review.

supporting_features.name: No communication side effects
supporting_features.detail: Never sends or schedules messages, issues offers, creates tasks, or claims that an external action occurred.

supporting_features.name: Aggregate workforce safeguard
supporting_features.detail: Uses fictional role cohorts for workflow coaching and prohibits employee ranking, individual judgments, or personnel decisions.

supporting_features.name: Validation and publication controls
supporting_features.detail: Four locked cases pass; Dataverse and exported artifacts remain unpublished Drafts requiring explicit approval.
